reader_summary.headline: Today, we are breaking down Rolls-Royce.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we are breaking down Rolls-Royce. A fair warning to those expecting to hear about luxury automobiles, that division was split from this business in the 1970s. But as we discuss the history of Rolls-Royce on this episode.

key_points.text: But as we discuss the history of Rolls-Royce on this episode.
Our guest is Graeme Forster from Orbis Investments.
Graeme walks us through the core business of Rolls-Royce in the aerospace market, the evolving duopoly of the wide-body aircraft engine manufacturers.
